bibl.title: Papyrus ethopoeae on the Trojan saga.
bibl.seg: Marco Perale, Papyrus ethopoeae on the Trojan saga.
bibl.note: Focuses on ethopoeae listed in APHex [Adespota Papyracea Hexametra] as nrr. 135-137, 139-141, and 144, offering a translation, a papyrological and philological apparatus, and a short commentary. Shows that Nonnian accentuative rules were used in rhetorical exercises in Egypt already in the late fourth century AD.
